let us do task 9 similar to -I'll load the repo-overview ability and then get you a comprehensive summary of this repository.Now let me gather the evidence I need for a comprehensive overview.Now let me check the repository structure to see all top-level directories:## What this is A collection of progressively advanced data science projects completed as part of the EVN DS Epochs 2026 training program. The repository showcases practical machine learning and data analysis work, from exploratory data analysis on hotel bookings to building predictive models for customer churn and car price estimation. ### Stack - **Language(s):** Python - **Framework / runtime:** Jupyter Notebook (Google Colab) - **Notable libraries:** Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn, Matplotlib, Seaborn, SQLite ## How it's organized 
task-1/          Hotel Booking Demand – EDA, identify cancellation prediction problem
task-2/          Northwind Database – SQL queries, customer/sales analysis
task-3/          Used Car Price – EDA, data cleaning, feature engineering
task-4/          Spotify Tracks – EDA, data visualization on audio features
task-5/          Car Price Prediction – ML regression models (Linear, Decision Tree, Random Forest)
task-6/          Customer Churn Prediction – ML classification models (Logistic, Decision Tree, Random Forest)
task-7 through task-9/ (Additional tasks not yet explored)
**How it fits together:** Each task builds on the previous one, progressing from basic exploratory analysis (Tasks 1–4) to supervised learning (Tasks 5–6). Tasks typically follow: load data → explore/visualize → preprocess → engineer features → train models → evaluate and compare → document insights. All work is done in Jupyter notebooks with results, visualizations, and documentation bundled together. ## How to run it No single entry point; each task is independent. For any task: 
bash
# Clone and navigate
git clone https://github.com/manukrishna804/EPOCHS-DATA-SCIENCE.git
cd task-N

# Install dependencies
pip install pandas numpy matplotlib seaborn scikit-learn jupyter

# Run the notebook
jupyter notebook
# Open the .ipynb file and run all cells
For SQL-based tasks (Task 2), load the Northwind database file directly into SQLite. Datasets are pre-packaged in each task directory. ## Try asking - What machine learning model performed best for predicting customer churn in task-6, and why? - How did you handle categorical variables and missing data in the car price prediction model (task-5)? - What feature engineering techniques were applied to the used car dataset in task-3, and did they improve predictions in task-5?,strictly adhere to task 9 instructions.
